semantic.justification: AQF9AG ports TimeZoneRule owned name/offset state, base-qualified assignment, equality/equivalence and start-query contract; InitialTimeZoneRule copy/clone and no-start methods; AnnualTimeZoneRule copy/adopt/deep assignment, date/year getters, Gregorian annual starts and inclusive next/previous/first/final selection. An explicit ownership argument projects C++ reference-copy versus pointer-adoption overloads; borrowed const types exclude mutators. Annual equality intentionally omits the numeric/name base while equivalence includes numeric offsets, per CALC-306. Source assertion-only Gregorian conversion status behavior is retained in the release flow. TimeArrayTimeZoneRule now owns sorted historical starts and ports copy/clone/assignment, full equality/equivalence, explicit count/index outputs and original first/final/next/previous searches with ordered previous-offset subtraction. The stable source sort preserves duplicates, signed zeros and source comparator behavior for nonfinite values; invalid buffer preconditions and native allocation/lifetime/ABI/concurrency remain uncertified. Unchanged ICU78.3 libraries/data match75189 combined annual/rule/transition/Calendar time cases; the probe and focused unit tests are limited to the stated operations. System/IANA/locale factories and full LibreOffice calendar/formatter/CSV integration remain incomplete.
